# Mangelhaft

A delivery written for netex-cli's tests with a defect of every class the
checking report has a case for: a reference to a quay and one to a day type
nothing defines, a stop place another document defines otherwise, a journey
without travel time, one whose times go back, a stop point placed nowhere and
without a position, a stop place and a line nothing refers to. Places, lines
and times are invented; licensed as the crate is (MIT OR Apache-2.0).
